description: Modify one existing EASY CODE Skill using the exact version returned by read_skill; conflicting concurrent changes are rejected.

propertyDescriptions.scope: Exact global or project scope of the Skill to modify.
propertyDescriptions.name: Exact Skill name within the selected scope.
propertyDescriptions.expectedVersion: 64-character version hash returned by read_skill before editing.
propertyDescriptions.skillMarkdown: Optional complete replacement SKILL.md with valid name and description frontmatter.
propertyDescriptions.files: Optional changes to supporting files; omitted files remain unchanged.
propertyDescriptions.files[].operation: upsert writes the supplied text; remove deletes that supporting file.
propertyDescriptions.files[].path: Relative path of a supporting file within the selected Skill.
propertyDescriptions.files[].content: Required for upsert and omitted for remove; full UTF-8 text content.

guidance: Read the current Skill and its version before modifying it. Preserve unrelated content and do not retry a version conflict without rereading.
